about.heading: THE VISION BEHIND THE CUTS
about.bioParagraph1: I am Shubh, a travel video editor and commercial ads creator specializing in turning raw footage into high-converting, visually breathtaking travel reels & campaigns.
about.bioParagraph2: Whether editing fast-paced viral Instagram Reels, luxury resort promo videos, or high-ROAS social media video ads for travel brands & tourism boards, my edits are meticulously engineered with frame-accurate beat matching, multi-layered sound design, bespoke 4K color profiles, and psychological hook structures.
about.feature1Desc: Capturing viewer focus in the first 1.5s with punchy cuts, audio risers, and sound SFX.
about.feature2Desc: Custom cinematic color palettes (Moody Alpine, Tropical Glow, Teal & Orange) tailored to brands.
about.feature3Desc: Atmospheric ambient audio, swooshes, risers, and beat-synced rhythm cuts for maximum impact.
about.feature4Desc: Converting ad edits for luxury resorts, travel agencies, and tour operators to boost bookings.

reviews.heading: WHAT MY TRAVEL CLIENTS SAY
reviews.subtitle: Real reviews, video project screenshots & ratings from travel brands, luxury resorts, and creators I edit for.

items.reviewText: Shubh turned our raw GoPro and drone footage into viral Instagram Reels that generated over 40+ direct tour inquiries in just 2 weeks. His beat matching and color grading are top tier!
The promotional ad campaign video Shubh edited for our luxury resort villas delivered our highest ROAS ever on Meta Ads. The sound design made the video feel like a high-end luxury movie trailer.
Finding an editor who understands frame pacing, hook retention, and aesthetic color grading is so rare. Shubh consistently delivers 4K reels that hit 100K+ views within hours!
